info.headline: Notify NYC - Traffic Delays - Brooklyn Queens Expressway (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-11-2026 at 03:25 AM.
Due to a vehicle collision, expect extensive eastbound traffic delays on the Brooklyn Queens Expressway at Morgan Avenue in Brooklyn. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
